assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
availability and testing of fixed fire protection
standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: regulator directive concerning danger tagging at TK-4211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control FIXED_FIRE_SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY: the availability and testing of fixed fire protection was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-4211 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in mustering and rescuing, specifically deploying an emergency response team. TK-4211 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 1 December 2004 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TK-4211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
